change: Exclude lowercase i and full-width ｉ from unconditional ambiguity warnings. Keep per-character scores below 0.80, four-candidate disagreement, and I/l/1/O/0 warnings.

unit_tests.regression_proof: The updated review tests failed for lowercase i against the original implementation and passed after the fix.

Single-character warning, per-candidate scores and mobile layout
Editing, verification and adoption preserve original warning positions and clean exports
Candidate-only disagreement, missing characters and empty candidates trigger warning

PDF native /Rotate plus manual counterclockwise correction, fresh detection and OCR

Manual selection, candidate click and TXT/CSV downloads after rotation

Rotation failure leaves image geometry and completed output intact, then can retry
